module: Rendering of speed bars and the AI navigation graph (roadArchitect / drivePath lineage): speed bars and curve, navgraph node selection and overlay of the world AI graph. Separate from render.lua because only the graph and speed tools use it. Composite module that draws via render/spheres, lines, tris and markup, with its own pool of temporary vec3s.
notes: Bar heights are the speed (m/s) multiplied by geom.getBarScale(), placed on the ground found by util.vertRaycast.
unitsInt: 0 or other = m/s, 1 = mph, 2 = kph (util.msToMph / util.msToKph).
Failing speeds (vels/velLimits empty), 30.0 m/s is used.
renderWorldGraphNodes uses the kd-tree graph.kdNodes; the graph expects nodeX/nodeY/nodeZ/nodeDepth, optionally nodeGroupId, groupCols, defaultNodeCol and sphereRadius (default 1.5).

renderVelocities.desc: Draws the speed bars of a spline: ceiling curve (Catmull-Rom over barPoints) colored by height, drop lines to the ground and speed labels at each point. No effect for fewer than 2 nodes.

spline.desc: Spline with nodes, barPoints, vels, velLimits, isLoop.

isBarsLimit.desc: true: uses velLimits (limits), false: vels (actual values).

elevScale.desc: Height corresponding to the red of the color ramp.

renderVelocitiesGraph.desc: Like renderVelocities for a graph path: if spline.divPoints exists, the curve follows the computed navgraph path and speeds are linearly interpolated between the chosen nodes (graphNodes/graphPath); otherwise falls back to barPoints. Labels only at the chosen nodes.

spline.desc: Spline with graphNodes, graphPath, divPoints, barPoints, vels, velLimits, isLoop.

renderNavGraph.desc: Draws the navigation graph: triangulated ribbons between spheres, centerline and node spheres with halo. The hovered node pulses.

navGraph.desc: Graph with lines (pL, pR, qL, qR, cL, cR) and nodes (table of vec3).

renderGraphPath.desc: Draws a graph path: path node spheres and lines between consecutive nodes.

path.desc: List of node keys in graphData.nodes.

graphData.desc: Graph data with the nodes field.

renderChosenNodes.desc: Draws the chosen navGraph nodes with a large pulsing sphere (to indicate they are part of the selection) and a numbered label.

graphData.desc: Graph data with the nodes field.

renderWorldGraphNodes.desc: Draws the spheres of the world AI graph nodes located within the given radius around the camera (kd-tree query). The sphere is placed at nodeZ + nodeDepth + 0.05 m and colored by group if groupCols exists.

graph.desc: World graph (nodeCount, kdNodes, nodeX, nodeY, nodeZ, nodeDepth...).

drawRadiusMeters.desc: Drawing radius around the camera, in meters.

renderWorldGraphNodeBackdrops.desc: Draws enlarged background spheres behind a list of world graph nodes (highlighting).

drawRadiusMeters.desc: Drawing radius around the camera, in meters.

nodeIdCount.desc: Number of valid identifiers in nodeIds.
